description:
Vision finally comes face-to-face with Ultron in the climactic battle of VisionQuest Season 1, Episode 8, bringing one of the MCU’s oldest synthetic rivalries full circle.

After the death of Jocasta, Ultron’s grief turns once again toward humanity. Rebuilding his physical body through a massive swarm of nanobots, Ultron launches an attack toward London capable of taking control of human neural systems and killing millions. Only Vision stands between him and another attempt to wipe humanity from the Earth.

But this final confrontation becomes more than a battle of strength.

Vision realizes that destroying Ultron may not stop the nanobot swarm, so he pulls them both into a simulated sitcom reality called UltraVision — a twisted reflection of the artificial world Wanda once created in WandaVision. Inside the simulation, Vision forces his creator to confront the grief, loss and loneliness driving his hatred of humanity.
